overview: A former U.S. soldier returns to his hometown to find it overrun by crime and corruption, which prompts him to clean house.
tagline: One man will stand up for what's right.

recs.blurb: A former street tough returns to his Philadelphia home after a stint in the military. Back on his home turf, he once again finds himself tangling with the mob…
A man is out for justice after a group of corrupt police officers are unable to catch his wife's killer.
A soldier returns home to his small town and exacts a deadly revenge on the thugs who tormented his dimwitted brother while he was away.
Set in Brazil, three kids who make a discovery in a garbage dump soon find themselves running from the cops and trying to right a terrible wrong.
A chilling vision of the House of Saddam Hussein comes to life through the eyes of the man who was forced to become the double of Hussein's sadistic son.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
Everything appears off-kilter when a man returns to his hometown after 25 years to visit his former lover.
Teenagers at a juvenile detention center, under the leadership of their counselor, gain self-esteem by playing football together.
A corrupt cop gets in over his head when he tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hit-woman.
In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
A rogue soldier turned outlaw is thrust into a relentless fight with a corrupt sheriff, his obedient deputies, and a dangerous drug cartel in order to protect…
